The Radium DI ECU Mount Kit replaces the heavy MIG-welded steel factory direct injection ECU mount with a lightweight aluminium bracket. It provides easier access to the right-hand side of the engine and is designed to work alongside the Radium fuel rail kit.
hl: Lightweight: Aluminium bracket replaces the heavy welded steel OEM mount
Improved Access: Easier access to the right-hand side of the engine
Fuel Rail Compatible: Designed to work with the Radium fuel rail kit
Construction: Laser cut and formed 5052 aluminium
